answer: A clone farm cannot occupy two bays of the same frame. An applicant bonds 1.84 POA and is issued one dyed thread tagged T-27. That thread must be the only line laced through bay B-8 of a tundra trellis for a 16-hour watch. Peers inspect a wet-fiber close-up at lacing, a wax knot seal matching the reserved map, and a bay photo that shows no second line. If another thread appears in B-8, or T-27 is still unlaced when the watch ends, the 1.84 POA bond is slashed, bay B-8 is retired for three epochs, and that key may not reuse tag T-27.
